pages.title: Dogs
pages.text: A patty or a tentacle, a stick, and any corn the pack grows — that's a $(item)Dino Dog$() or a $(item)Kraken Dog$(). Fair food for a world that is, itself, unfair.

pages.title: Skewers & Sweets
pages.text: The $(item)Sea Viper Skewer$() grants real strength with a small chance of residual venom. Balance the risk with $(item)Strawberry Shortcake$() — nine strawberries, milk, and a pie crust.
$(item)Fried Stink Bug$() — a dead stink bug, crisped in butter in the cooking pot. A delicacy in several real cuisines and now, regrettably, in yours.
